headline: Oil Rises To 101.39 From 100.95 As The Gain Widens To 1.93 Percent
narrative: Oil rose to 101.39 from 100.95, and the gain widened to 1.93 percent from 1.49 percent. The oil pipe is the cash price of crude, so the higher print means crude cash value rose against the prior reading. The VIX rose to 20.12 from 19.55, and the 10-year yield rose to 4.97 percent from 4.95 percent.
author: jordan
